profile.capture_circumstance: A quiet human observer occupies the reachable near-side aisle and accepts ordinary occlusion and focus compromise.

dynamic_range_contract.highlight_behavior: the lamp housing rolls gradually while its filament core may clip
dynamic_range_contract.middle_gray_anchor: the courier's face and neutral gray work shirt
dynamic_range_contract.narrative_reason: Keep attention on the discovery rather than making the whole workshop equally legible.
dynamic_range_contract.shadow_behavior: unlit shelf gaps fall below the texture floor without gray HDR lift

profile.focus_optics_contract: Conversational perspective with motivated focus falloff and no universal shallow-depth template.
profile.illumination_contract: The north window and existing desk lamp are the only shape-producing sources; no invented beauty or rim light.
profile.material_response_contract: Skin, hair, cotton, concrete, painted steel, glass and wood preserve independent roughness, edge and reflection behavior.
profile.performance_composition_contract: Task-led observed behavior with plausible unused space, mild occlusion and no publicity pose.
profile.set_causality_contract: Every utility, object, contact, age trace and dressing choice follows workshop use and construction.
profile.skin_response_contract: Natural dry skin retains continuous hue/value transitions and broad source-shaped highlights without uniform oil film.
profile.tone_contrast_contract: Protected middle tones, restrained local contrast and gradual source-specific highlight transition.
